user.title: VTherm Smart Boiler
user.description: Monitors your boiler read-only: it never writes to the boiler or to VT. Pick a name and the level of detail.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name.
data_description.level: Simple shows the essentials with cautious defaults; advanced shows every parameter. The level changes only what you see, never how the plugin behaves.

signals.title: Boiler signals
signals.description: Pick the entity that provides each signal. Flame and flow temperature are required; every other signal enables more of the monitor. The plugin only reads these entities.

data_description.flame: On while the burner burns. Every burner-cycle metric comes from it: the wrong entity gives wrong starts and burn times.
data_description.flow: Water leaving the boiler. Used for hot water availability, emitter power and telling DHW runs from heating.
data_description.return: Water coming back to the boiler. Enables the condensing share; without it condensing cannot be judged.
data_description.modulation: Burner modulation in percent. With the boiler's power range it estimates heat output and gas use.
data_description.dhw_active: On while the boiler heats domestic hot water. Without it DHW runs are inferred with less certainty and some may count as heating.
data_description.pressure: Enables the pressure alarms and the falling-pressure warning.
data_description.outdoor: The boiler's own outdoor sensor. Used for degree-days and checked against the weather entity.
data_description.ch_setpoint: The flow setpoint the boiler works to. Helps tell DHW runs from heating.
data_description.ch_active: On while the boiler heats the rooms. Helps tell DHW from heating when there is no DHW signal.
data_description.pump_running: On while the heating pump runs. Recorded now; the low-flow warning will need it.
data_description.flue_gas: Enables the flue gas alarm and the early warning of a fouling heat exchanger.
data_description.gas_meter: A cumulative gas or energy meter. Gives measured gas per degree-day instead of an estimate.
data_description.room_setpoint: The room setpoint a wired thermostat sends to the boiler, if there is one. Recorded for the assessment.
data_description.room_temperature: The room temperature a wired thermostat sends to the boiler, if there is one. Recorded for the assessment.
data_description.weather: Its forecasts are recorded for later forecast features and its temperature stands in for a missing outdoor sensor. No data leaves your Home Assistant.

boiler.title: Boiler
boiler.description: What you know about your boiler. Leave unknown values empty: the plugin then says what it cannot judge.

data.class: What the boiler's integration can do
data.shared_return: Heating and DHW share the return sensor

data_description.class: Flow setpoint, curve parameters only, on/off or read-only. Control (experimental) needs "Flow setpoint"; with the other classes the plugin only monitors.
data_description.dhw: None, a storage tank or a combi boiler. Used to interpret DHW runs.
data_description.condensing: Condensing boilers get flue gas limits for condensing appliances; for other boilers the absolute flue gas alarm is off.
data_description.boiler_min_power: Lowest heating power from the manual, in kW. Compared with the building load: a load often below it means the boiler must cycle.
data_description.boiler_max_power: Highest heating power in kW. With the minimum and the modulation it estimates heat output.
data_description.max_ch_setpoint: Highest flow temperature in heating, in °C. Flow above it points to a DHW run.
data_description.gas_at_min_power: Gas per hour at minimum power, in your gas meter's unit. With the modulation it estimates gas use when there is no meter.
data_description.gas_at_max_power: Gas per hour at maximum power, in the same unit.
data_description.modulation_scale: Whether 0 % is the minimum power (the OpenTherm definition) or the value is a percentage of maximum power. The wrong choice skews heat and gas estimates.
data_description.shared_return: Tick when one return sensor serves both. DHW runs are then kept out of the heating metrics.

circuit.title: Heating circuit {number}
circuit.description: How this circuit's water temperature is set.

data_description.control: Unmixed and shared: straight from the boiler. Through the boiler: a second circuit the boiler mixes. Separately: an external mixing controller. Passive fixed: a thermostatic mixing valve.
data_description.max_flow: The most this circuit may receive, in °C, e.g. underfloor heating on an unmixed loop. Recorded now; control will treat it as a hard limit.
data_description.fixed_temperature: Needed for a passive fixed circuit: the valve's setting in °C.
data_description.flow_entity: A mixed circuit's own flow temperature. Without it the heat reaching that circuit cannot be told.
data_description.add_another: Tick to describe one more circuit after this one.

zones.title: VT zones
zones.description: Pick the Versatile Thermostat zones heated by this boiler. Zones not picked are ignored.

data_description.zones: Only VT climate entities are offered. The plugin only reads them.

data_description.circuit: The heating circuit this zone is on.
data_description.emitter: Radiators, underfloor or convectors. Sets the EN 442 exponent of the emitter power.
data_description.foreign_heat: A fireplace, stove or electric heater in this room, not the sun: a switch or binary sensor that is on while it heats, or a power or temperature sensor. Shown as foreign heat for the zone.
data_description.reference_output_w: The emitters' output at their reference condition, in W. Only for an absolute output estimate.
data_description.exponent: Overrides the EN 442 exponent of the emitter type.
data_description.power_threshold: A power source counts as heating above this, in W. Default 100 W.
data_description.temperature_threshold: Needed for a temperature source: it counts as heating above this, in °C.

building.title: Building
building.description: A first estimate of your house's heat loss; recorded heating days refine it. Leave empty what you do not know.

data_description.floor_area: In m². With the insulation class it gives a rough first estimate.
data_description.insulation: Poor, average, good or very good.
data_description.thermal_mass: How slowly the house cools. Recorded for later forecast features.
data_description.design_load_kw: Your own heat-loss calculation, in kW at the design outdoor temperature. Wins over the rough estimate.
data_description.loss_coefficient: Heat loss per kelvin, in kW/K, if you know it. Wins over every estimate.
data_description.heating_threshold: Outdoor temperature above which the house needs no heating, in °C; also the degree-day base. Default 15 °C.
data_description.design_outdoor: The coldest outdoor temperature your design load refers to, in °C. Default −15 °C.

reference.title: Reference room
reference.description: One room temperature and setpoint for controllers that need a single room.

data_description.strategy: Largest deficit follows the room furthest below its setpoint; a chosen zone always uses one room; average uses every heating room.
data_description.switch_margin: Another room must be this much colder before the reference switches, in K. Smaller follows faster but switches more often, which can disturb an external controller.

data_description.condensing_return: A return below this counts as condensing, in °C. Default 55 °C.
data_description.short_burn_min: Burns shorter than this count as short, in minutes. Default 10.
data_description.monitoring_days: Days of data before the verdict is given, and later before control can be enabled. Default 7; shorter is not allowed.
data_description.near_room_k: Water within this of the room counts as no hot water, in K. Default 3.
data_description.foreign_heat_hold_min: How long a room still counts as warmed after its source stops, in minutes. Default 60.
data_description.pressure_low_warning: Pressure below this raises a warning, in bar. Default 1.0. Take the value from your boiler's manual.
data_description.pressure_low_alarm: Pressure below this raises an alarm, in bar. Default 0.7. Must be below the warning.
data_description.pressure_high_warning: Pressure above this raises a warning, in bar. Default 2.5.
data_description.pressure_high_alarm: Pressure above this raises an alarm, in bar. Default 2.8, below a typical 3 bar safety valve. Must be above the warning.
data_description.flue_gas_warning: Flue gas above this raises a warning on a condensing boiler, in °C. Default 85 °C.
data_description.flue_gas_alarm: Flue gas above this raises an alarm, in °C. Default 100 °C. A limit set too high warns too late for plastic flue pipes.
data_description.starts_per_hour_limit: More burner starts than this in an hour raise a warning. Default 12.
data_description.unstable_burns_limit: More than this many burns under a minute in a day raise a warning. Default 10.

error.min_power_not_below_max: The minimum power must be below the maximum power.
error.fixed_temperature_missing: A passive fixed circuit needs its fixed temperature.
error.foreign_heat_unsupported: Only switches, binary sensors and power or temperature sensors can be heat sources.
error.temperature_threshold_missing: A temperature source needs a temperature threshold (advanced level).
error.reference_zone_unknown: Pick one of the configured zones.

abort.implausible_parameter: A parameter is outside its plausible range.
abort.unknown_circuit: A zone refers to a circuit that does not exist.
abort.fixed_temperature_missing: A passive fixed circuit needs its fixed temperature.
abort.reference_zone_unknown: The chosen reference zone is not one of the zones.
abort.duplicate_circuit: Two circuits have the same name.
abort.no_circuit: At least one circuit is needed.
abort.invalid_control: The control settings cannot be used.
abort.alarm_limits_out_of_order: An alarm limit must lie beyond its warning limit.

data_description.level: Simple shows the essentials; advanced shows every parameter.

control.title: Control (experimental)
control.description: How the plugin writes the flow setpoint to the boiler. Control stays off until you switch it on, and only after the monitoring period. Choose "No control" to keep monitoring only.

data_description.write_path: No control (default); a writable entity you pick, e.g. an EMS-ESP or ESPHome OpenTherm number; the OpenTherm Gateway through Home Assistant's OpenTherm Gateway integration; or the OTGW firmware's MQTT commands. Pick the path your boiler interface really offers: a wrong one means writes that fail or go nowhere.
data_description.topology: How the gateway sits between thermostat and boiler. With a thermostat: on hand-back the thermostat takes over. Stand-alone, without a thermostat: on hand-back, and whenever Home Assistant stops for more than about a minute, the boiler stops heating. Monitor mode: the gateway only listens and control is not possible. Virtual: a controller on the Home Assistant side, e.g. ESPHome, drives the boiler. Required; declare it as it is — the plugin never changes the gateway's mode.
data_description.confirmed_entity: The entity that reports the setpoint the boiler received, e.g. the gateway's control setpoint sensor. Required: every write is checked against it, and a write the boiler ignores or another controller overwrites is reported. Picking the value you write instead of the boiler's report hides both.

control_entity.title: Writable entity
control_entity.description: The entity that takes the flow setpoint, and how control is handed back.

data_description.setpoint_entity: A number or input_number that sets the boiler's flow temperature.
data_description.write_type: Expiring: the device drops the value unless it is repeated; it is repeated every 30 s. Persistent: stored in the boiler's memory, and every write wears it; written only on a change of at least the minimum change and within a daily cap. Held: the device keeps the value and sends it on itself; written on change only. Unknown (default) counts as persistent. Expiring on a device that stores each write would write its memory every 30 s and wear it out.
data_description.ch_entity: Optional. A switch that turns heating on and off. Without it, "off" is written as a low setpoint.
data_description.hand_back: How control returns to the boiler on every exit: write a hand-back value; stop writing and let the device's own timeout take over, for expiring writes only; or turn off a switch that enables external control. Required; control cannot be switched on without it.
data_description.hand_back_value: The setpoint written on hand-back, for the value method: what the boiler uses on its own, or 0 if that returns control to it. Required for the value method.
data_description.hand_back_entity: For the switch method: the switch that enables external control. It is turned on when control starts and off on hand-back.

control_gateway.title: OpenTherm Gateway
control_gateway.description: The gateway set up in Home Assistant's OpenTherm Gateway integration.

data_description.gateway_id: The ID you gave the gateway in the OpenTherm Gateway integration. The control setpoint is repeated every 30 s; on hand-back it is set to 0, which returns control to the thermostat, or ends heating without one.

data_description.mqtt_top: The MQTT topic prefix set in the OTGW firmware. Default OTGW.
data_description.mqtt_node: The node name set in the OTGW firmware. A wrong prefix or node name sends commands nowhere; the read-back then reports them as ignored.

control_curve.title: Heating curve and limits
control_curve.description: The flow temperature the house needs at each outdoor temperature, and the limits no setpoint may pass.

data_description.design_outdoor: The coldest outdoor temperature your heating is designed for, in °C. Default: the building's design outdoor temperature, or −15 °C.
data_description.design_flow: The flow temperature the heating needs at the design outdoor temperature, in °C, e.g. the value on your boiler's own curve. Required; there is no default. Too high wastes gas and makes the burner cycle; too low leaves rooms cold in hard frost.
data_description.hard_min: No setpoint below this, in °C. Default 25 °C.
data_description.hard_max: No setpoint above this, whatever the curve or a correction asks, in °C. Default 70 °C. Underfloor heating also needs its circuit's maximum flow.
data_description.summer_threshold: Above this effective outdoor temperature control does not heat, in °C. Default 20 °C.
data_description.room: The room temperature the curve is built for, in °C. Default 20 °C.
data_description.exponent: How the curve bends. Empty picks it from the emitters: radiators 1.3, convectors 1.4, underfloor 1.1.
data_description.offset: Shifts the whole curve up or down, in K. Default 0.
data_description.ceiling_band: How far above the curve a comfort correction may go, in K. Default 10 K; 0 turns correction off in effect.
data_description.fallback_setpoint: The setpoint used while no outdoor temperature is known, in °C. Empty: the curve at 0 °C outside.
data_description.frost_limit: Any zone colder than this starts heating, whatever else applies, in °C. Default 5 °C.
data_description.frost_release: Frost protection ends once every zone is above this, in °C. Default 7 °C.

control_behaviour.title: Control behaviour
control_behaviour.description: Anti-cycling, write guards and learning pauses. Every default is the cautious one.

data_description.min_burn_min: Once lit, the burner is kept on at least this long, in minutes. Default 5. Shorter lets the boiler cycle.
data_description.min_pause_min: After it stops, the burner stays off at least this long, in minutes. Default 5. Frost protection is not held back.
data_description.max_starts_per_hour: The most burner starts control may cause in an hour. Default 6.
data_description.min_on_min: Heating, once switched on, stays on at least this long, in minutes. Default 5.
data_description.min_off_min: Heating, once switched off, stays off at least this long, in minutes. Default 5.
data_description.max_switches_per_hour: The most heating on/off switchings in an hour. Default 6.
data_description.ramp_k_per_min: The fastest setpoint change, in K per minute. Default 1. Faster changes stress the boiler and make zones overshoot.
data_description.decision_interval_min: How often the setpoint is decided anew, in minutes. Default 5.
data_description.min_change: The smallest setpoint change written for a persistent or unknown write type, in K. Default 1. Smaller wears the boiler's memory faster.
data_description.daily_cap: The most writes a day for a persistent or unknown write type. Default 48.
data_description.cap_reaction: Hold (default): keep the last value and raise an alarm. Hand back: return control to the boiler.
data_description.off_setpoint: Written for "off" when there is no heating switch, in °C. Default 10 °C.
data_description.count_threshold: Heating is needed when at least this many zones call for heat. Default 1.
data_description.power_threshold_kw: Optional: heating is needed when the calling zones' power adds up to this, in kW.
data_description.opening_threshold: Optional: heating is needed when the zones' valve openings add up to this, in %.
data_description.learning_pauses: Pause SmartPI learning while hot water runs, while foreign heat warms a zone and while the water temperature swings, so it does not learn what the boiler did. Default on.
data_description.comfort_correction: Raise the setpoint a step while a zone's valve is fully open and its room stays short of the setpoint, within the room for correction; lower it again once every zone is satisfied. Default on.

control_alarms.title: Alarm reactions
control_alarms.description: What control does while an alarm is active: information only, or hand control back to the boiler until you switch control off and on again.

data_description.outside_change: Default: hand back — another controller writes to the boiler too, and the plugin does not fight it.

blocked_no_write_path.message: Control is not set up: choose in the options how the plugin writes to the boiler. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_boiler_not_flow_setpoint.message: Control needs a boiler of the class "Flow setpoint". Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_setpoint_entity.message: Pick the entity that takes the flow setpoint. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_hand_back.message: Choose how control is handed back to the boiler: a value, the device's own timeout or a switch. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_gateway.message: Enter the OpenTherm Gateway ID. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_mqtt_topic.message: Enter the gateway's MQTT topic prefix and node name. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_confirmed_setpoint.message: Pick the entity that reports the setpoint the boiler received (read-back). Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_no_topology.message: Declare how the gateway is connected. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_topology_no_control.message: The gateway runs in monitor mode and cannot control the boiler. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_curve_not_entered.message: Enter the heating curve, at least the design flow temperature. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_one_direct_circuit_only.message: This version controls only one circuit fed straight from the boiler (unmixed, or with a fixed thermostatic mixing valve). Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_underfloor_without_max_flow.message: Underfloor heating on an unmixed circuit needs a maximum flow temperature for that circuit. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_ha_starting.message: Home Assistant is still starting. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_monitoring_period.message: Control becomes available once the monitoring period has passed. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_vt_central_boiler_active.message: Versatile Thermostat's own central boiler is configured. Remove it first, so that only one controller drives the boiler. Other reasons: {others}.

blocked_control_error.message: Control stopped after an internal error. Check the log, then switch control off and on again. Other reasons: {others}.

auto_tpi_blocked.title: Auto-TPI cannot learn in some zones
auto_tpi_blocked.description: These zones run Auto-TPI and are marked in Versatile Thermostat as used by the central boiler, but VT's central boiler is not configured, so Auto-TPI skips learning in them: {zones}. Clear the option "used by the central boiler" in each zone's VT configuration.
